user.title: Choose integration type
user.description: Select the CallMeBot integration to configure.

telegram_call.title: Configure Telegram calls
telegram_call.description: Enter a Telegram username beginning with `@` or a full international phone number such as `+1234567890`. A test call will validate access. If authorization is missing, [authenticate the Telegram recipient](https://api2.callmebot.com/txt/auth.php) and try again.

telegram_call_confirm.title: Create Telegram Call notify entity
telegram_call_confirm.description: CallMeBot completed the test call for `{recipient}`. Submit to create the notify entity.

telegram_text.title: Configure Telegram text messages
telegram_text.description: Enter a Telegram username beginning with `@` or a full international phone number such as `+1234567890`. A test message will be sent to validate access. If CallMeBot reports permission denied, [authenticate the Telegram recipient](https://api2.callmebot.com/txt/login.php) and try again.

telegram_text_confirm.title: Create Telegram notify entity
telegram_text_confirm.description: CallMeBot accepted the test message for `{recipient}`. Submit to create the notify entity.
